text.4: How This Book Works This is not an ordinary word search. Every puzzle hides a sentence. 1. Find and cross out every word in the list. They run in all eight directions, including backwards. 2. Read the letters you did not cross out, left to right and top to bottom. They spell a statement of fact about the night Silas Croft died. 3. Four puzzles make one chapter, and one chapter clears one suspect. Cross that name off the list at the front of the book. 4. When eleven names are gone, the twelfth is your answer — and the final chapter will confirm it. A promise. Every clue in this book is true, every alibi holds, and exactly one person can be guilty. The solution has been checked by machine: no chapter is redundant, and no second suspect survives all twelve. Solutions to every grid begin on the page marked Answers. Try not to look. 4
text.5: The Case THISTLEWICK GREEN · OCTOBER 1926 Silas Croft collected rents for the Thistlewick estate for nineteen years, and in nineteen years he made no friends at all. On the night of the sixteenth of October he was found at the foot of the mill stairs, his lantern still burning beside him. It rained from seven until midnight. The mill door was locked. Three keys to it exist. Twelve people in this village had reason to wish Silas Croft gone. Eleven of them can prove where they were. Your task is to find out which eleven. Cross off each name as you clear it. 5
text.6: The Twelve Rose Penhale Baker. Croft raised her rent twice in one year. Arthur Quill Postmaster. Owed Croft eleven pounds and could not pay. Cecily Thorne Physician. Croft refused her a lease on the old surgery. Ned Harrow Gardener at the Hall. Croft had him dismissed once before. Ivy Ballantyne Schoolmistress. Croft wanted the school field for grazing. Julian Fenn Vicar. Croft had stopped the church rate in protest. Dorcas Pike Housekeeper at the Hall. Twenty years of service, no pension promised. Tobias Wren Clockmaker. Croft never paid for the repair of the hall clock. Lavinia Frost Florist. Croft was to take her greenhouse for the new road. Sam Ogden Publican. Croft had objected to the renewal of his licence. Bea Longstaff Seamstress. Her brother was turned out of his cottage by Croft. Gideon Marsh Miller. Croft had doubled the toll on his grain. One of these people is lying. 6
text.7: CHAPTER 1 The Bakery at Dusk The ovens of Penhale's bakery are never cold, and on the night Silas Croft died they burned until eleven. Four puzzles follow. Read the leftover letters of each. 7
